title: Rig Report Event
description: Write event envelope for the rig.report event ledger. Each event represents a lifecycle transition: report created, duplicate detected, triaged, accepted, promoted, etc. The event ledger is the source of truth; projections are derived read models.

event_id.description: Unique event identifier. Generated deterministically from content.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

report_id.description: Report identifier this event relates to.

report_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical report payload at time of event.

previous_event_sha256.description: SHA256 of the previous event in the ledger chain. Null for the first event in the ledger.

payload.description: Event payload — contains the report envelope for report.created, or decision metadata for lifecycle events. Content varies by event_kind.
